Boundary Surface's Network whose curves run on past the outer crossing curves (mitcad#2333, GitHub mitcad/Mitcad#609), on the reported network rebuilt as a design (opened with --open, never committed; tools/cli/boundary-network-reported-test.cmake). All in the xy plane: three curves one way in Sketch1 (F1: a cubic spline c5 from (0, 40) to (100, 75), a cubic spline c10 from (5, 0) to (105, 35) and a line c13 from (20, -40) to (115, -5)) and two crossing cubic splines, Sketch2's c5 (F2) from the top curve at (21.25, 50.95) to the line at (43.75, -31.25) and Sketch3's c5 (F3) from the top curve at (67.69, 64.23) to the line at (91.25, -13.75). The curves one way run on past both crossing curves. BoundarySurface1 (F4) failed with 'no surface runs through the network'; now each curve is cut back to its first and last crossing and the face spans the region between the outer crossings.

One face through all five curves: the region the top curve, the right crossing curve, the line and the left crossing curve close (4088.33 mm2, by the curves sampled), the parts beyond the crossings left off.
